changes.evidence: Alice's police job with the Eastview Police Department was in 2023, shown only in the episode 6 flashback to the Kaplan car crash. She then lost a string of jobs because of the curse. In the present (episode 2) she is a Westview Shopping Mall security guard, and she is fired for tackling Teen just before Agatha recruits her into the coven. MCU Wiki lists both the police department and mall security as former. The police stage is backstory. The mall job is the group she has when the story starts, and she leaves it in episode 2.

changes.evidence: Isaiah's U.S. Army service was in the Korean War. He was then held and experimented on for about 30 years, until a nurse faked his death and freed him in the 1980s. In The Falcon and the Winter Soldier he is a recluse in Baltimore and has long been out of the Army, so the Army stage is backstory. His arrest in Brave New World is custody, not a group, so it is left as it is.

Marc served in the Marine Corps before the series. He went AWOL in a fugue state, was discharged, and became a mercenary and then Khonshu's avatar, all before Moon Knight begins. The record's order also wrongly says he left the gallery to join the Marines. In the series, Steven works at the National Art Gallery gift shop and is fired in episode 2 ('Summon the Suit'). That firing is what the Independent stage records.
